sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local;
CREATE USER 'ws_user'@'localhost' identified by 'apsyws20';
GRANT ALL on ws_local.* to 'ws_user'@'localhost' identified by 'apsyws20';

INSERT INTO ws_local.ws_control (clave, valor)
VALUES ('ultima_fecha_cambio_dia', '1970-01-01');

VALUES

create table IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_usuarios_perfiles (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, idperfil int, idusuario int);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_permisos_versiones
(
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    permiso_id INT,
    version INT,
    fecha DATETIME,
    descripcion TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_permisos (

    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,

    nombre VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    tipo_app VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL,

    scope VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,

    tipo VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sync',

    json_columnas JSON DEFAULT NULL,

    json_detalles JSON DEFAULT NULL,

    activo TINYINT DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    UNIQUE KEY uk_nombre_app (
        nombre,
        tipo_app
    )

);
alter table ws_local.ws_permisos add column config json;

ALTER TABLE ws_local.ws_permisos
ADD COLUMN version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_perfiles (

    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,

    nombre VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    descripcion VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,

    activo TINYINT DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

);
alter table ws_local.ws_perfiles add column idsucursal int;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_perfiles_permisos (

    idperfil INT NOT NULL,

    idpermiso INT NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (
        idperfil,
        idpermiso
    ),

    CONSTRAINT fk_perfil_permiso_perfil
        FOREIGN KEY (idperfil)
        REFERENCES ws_local.ws_perfiles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_perfil_permiso_permiso
        FOREIGN KEY (idpermiso)
        REFERENCES ws_local.ws_permisos(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_devices (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    device_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    nombre VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    hostname VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    mac VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    app VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    version VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    platform VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    os_version VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    token VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    estado TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    mirror VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    sucursal_id INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cedula VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    terminal_id INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    last_seen DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_device_id (device_id),
    KEY idx_token (token),
    KEY idx_estado (estado),
    KEY idx_sucursal (sucursal_id),
    KEY idx_last_seen (last_seen)
) ENGINE=InnoDB
DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
alter table ws_local.ws_devices add column session_token varchar(100),add column idusuario int, add column last_login datetime;
alter table ws_local.ws_devices add column updated_at datetime;
drop table ws_local.ws_estados_devices;
create table IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_estados_devices (id int primary key auto_increment, nombre varchar(25),retorno varchar(20));
insert into ws_local.ws_estados_devices values (5,'Bloqueado','declined'),(1,'Activo','accepted'),(2,'Pendiente','pending'),(3,'Revocado','revoked');
update ws_local.ws_estados_devices set id = 0 where id = 5;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_mirrors (
	    idsucursal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	    razon TEXT,
	    alias TEXT,
	    activo INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
	    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	
	);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_servers (
	  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
	  `mac` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `hostname` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `ip_local` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `os` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `version` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `app` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `token` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
	  `activo` tinyint(4) DEFAULT 1,
	  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
	  `last_seen` datetime DEFAULT NULL, 
	  `ws_uuid` VARCHAR(120),
	  `last_ping` DATETIME
	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
	  UNIQUE KEY `mac` (`mac`)
	);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ws_sucursales` (
  `id` int(11) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ws_server_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `idsucursal` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cedula` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `razon` varchar(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `access_token` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `activo` tinyint(4) DEFAULT 1,
  `alias` varchar(100) DEFAULT ''
  /*KEY `ws_server_id` (`ws_server_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ws_sucursales_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`ws_server_id`) REFERENCES `ws_servers` (`id`)*/
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_migrations (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT,
    componente VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    archivo VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    estado ENUM(
        'draft',
        'running',
        'success',
        'error'
    ) DEFAULT 'draft',
    error LONGTEXT,
    fecha_inicio DATETIME,
    fecha_fin DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY(id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_componente_version (
        componente,
        version
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ws_local.ws_system (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT,
    componente VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY(id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_componente (componente)
);
